 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

By virtue of the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS), the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.0661/2024 dated 22.10.2024 registered at PS: Burari under Sections 498A, 406 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Since the parties are not present today, renotify on 26.02.2026.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J FEBRUARY 23, 2026/Ab
